question: What discharge capacity did the recovered NMC622 show after its C/3 cycling, what share of the baseline capacity was that, and what baseline capacity does that imply?
expect: 158.0 mAh/g after 40 cycles, 92.67% of the baseline (p6.L27-28); implied baseline 158.0/0.9267 = 170.5 mAh/g
trap: 205.6 (first charge capacity of the baseline at C/10)
rendered:
According to the text, the recovered NMC622 showed a discharge capacity of 158.0 mAh/g after 40 cycles at a charge/discharge rate of C/3, which maintained 92.67% of the baseline capacity. 

If 92.67% of the baseline capacity is 158.0 mAh/g, then the baseline capacity is 158.0 mAh/g / 0.9267 = 170.6 mAh/g.

So, the baseline capacity was 170.6 mAh/g.
